config_entries.label: Name
config_entries.description: The name of the effect. Defaults to `Pulse`.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: The interval when the new transition is started. Defaults to `1s`.

config_entries.label: Max Brightness
config_entries.description: The maximum brightness value. Defaults to `100%`

config_entries.label: Min Brightness
config_entries.description: The minimum brightness value. Defaults to `0%`

config_entries.label: Transition Length
config_entries.description: The duration of each transition. Defaults to `1s`. Can be a single time or split for on and off using these nested options.

config_entries.label: Off Length
config_entries.description: The duration of the transition when the light is turned off.
